name: Nakayoshi Dousei Seikatsu
source:
"Let's have a good time today too."
A good time... that was a sex reference. It was our special phrase.

Misaki and you shared a summer apartment together in the city. She welcomed you home each day with a smile. Each night she dedicated herself to you with total love.

She was more than a lover. The lewdness becomes body modification and sex slavery.
